name: Tanseisha Co., Ltd.
summary: Tanseisha Co., Ltd. engages in the research, planning, design, layout, production, construction, and operation of commercial, public, hospitality, event, and business and cultural spaces in Japan. The company's research and planning services comprise consulting, research and analysis, planning, coordination, branding, and project management; and design and layout services comprising design concept, basic layout, and execution design, as well as the proposal for creative media spaces.
